title.narrative: Evidence focused on child labour, online protection, child marriage and children on the move. Policies/action plans drafted for Punjab/GB. CP policies finalized, approved in GB. ;Advancements in alternative care reforms and capacities of NHRIs strengthened. Child Justice work initiated. Health-interoperable birth registration work commenced.

Country has a birth registration service within the civil registration system in which: i) Births are registered without discrimination; ii) Civil registration system is in place to reach all districts/sub-districts, Text

baseline.value: (i) BR by-laws in Sindh drafted; (ii) CRVS rules available in KP (not inclusive)

target.value: 2027:Birth health Interoperable Tool implemented in at least 30 health facilities across Pakistan to register without discrimination

actual.value: 2024:A technical assistance firm has been taken onboard for the interoperable birth registration system support
